holderPosition.legalForm: Margin position in a Hyperliquid HIP-3 perpetual futures market on a company's valuation, cash-settled in USDH; VNTL Markets S.A. (Panama) deployed the markets and ran the front end, and its Terms say it was not a counterparty
holderPosition.says: A trader held no token, share, SPV interest or claim on any asset: 'you do not have any underlying economic ownership in the company - you're merely speculating on its valuation change.' Every pre-IPO, index and commodity market was settled at operator-set marks and halted between 15 and 18 June 2026, so no position survives.

statements.about: the SPACEX, OPENAI and ANTHROPIC markets
statements.says: 'When you have a position in a company on Ventuals, you do not have any underlying economic ownership in the company - you're merely speculating on its valuation change.' Valuations are quoted in Valuation Units of one billion.
Oracle price = 1/3 x Notice valuation estimate + 2/3 x 2-hour EMA of Ventuals' own mark price, pushed about every 3 seconds.

statements.says: Sunset: from 9:30am ET 2026-06-15 the OPENAI and ANTHROPIC marks froze at their 24-hour TWAPs and funding went to 0; OPENAI halted 10:30am ET and settled at $1,341.80, ANTHROPIC halted 11:30am ET and settled at $1,618.90; commodity markets froze to CME prices from 2:20pm ET and index markets at 4:00pm ET on 2026-06-18. All open positions settled automatically.

statements.about: the vHYPE vault token (not the pre-IPO product)
statements.says: 100% of vHYPE holders may withdraw their deposited HYPE 1:1 plus accrued native staking yield, batch-processed from 10am ET 2026-06-19 and every 24-72 hours after; no fees were ever taken on vHYPE.

Never a token: no SPV, share, holding entity, custodian, Solana mint or program existed at any point; the product was a synthetic perpetual on Hyperliquid, settled at the venue's own TWAP because 'these markets do not have a realtime external reference price'.

chainFacts.says: No Solana mint, program or token exists for the product; positions were HyperCore margin entries, which no Tokenizario reader can read.
chainFacts.source: RWA Sonar dossier keyGovernance and authorityFacts

outside.says: Panamanian law and the Panama Arbitration Law; arbitration in Panama City at the Panama Conciliation and Arbitration Centre, no class claims, liability capped at the greater of PAB 100.00 and fees paid in the previous twelve months.
USDH was bridged to USDC on HyperCore or HyperEVM; as of 2026-09-18 the official USDH route ends at direct redemption with Bridge, which requires KYC/KYB.

verdict.summary: There is no token to restate: a Ventuals position was a margin entry in a Hyperliquid perpetual, and every market was settled and halted in June 2026. The parties' own statements are still recorded, the operator's no-ownership disclaimer, its oracle formula and its settlement prices, so the record shows why the catalogue entry is a derivative venue and not a tokenized asset.
